# Delivery planning

Default: one integrated implementation child, automatic delivery, no optional functional verification. Add checks only when requested. The existing parent coordinates; do not create coordination siblings, build/deploy tasks or readiness placeholders.

Every child needs executionProfile `{system:"nestos-work-delivery",id:"release"|"source"|"verification",revision:"1"}`. Honor frozen preferences:
- none+release (default): one release implementation; host integrates, builds/replaces, checks startup and cleans.
- quick+release: focused checks in the implementation Session.
- full+release: exactly one independent read-only verification child directly after implementation.
- none+build: build then manual review; no automatic replacement/integration/cleanup.
- none+source: integrate source without build/replacement.

Split source children only for independent delivery/approval, cross-project ownership or substantial safe parallelism. Each needs splitJustification (30–2000 characters) explaining benefit over handoff cost and must precede the single integration child. Complexity, duration, file/package counts and checklists alone do not justify splitting.

Implementation owns its files, local commits and requested checks in one Session/worktree. Management batches repository integration: analyze → frozen authorization → integrate → requested build/replace → acceptance → cleanup. Automatic mode integrates conflict-free scopes; real conflicts require choices in the original Session. Read-only verification consumes the matching management deployment receipt without edits or redeployment. Formal receipts, artifact integrity, startup health and resource ownership remain required; never replay unknown operations or count skipped checks as passed.
